overview: Lava materials should read as cooled basalt-like crust plus a hot fissure network. The family should stay opaque-first, with emissive constrained inside cracks rather than flooding the full surface.
common_failure_modes: orange tint with no crust separation
cracks too soft to read in a single frame
dark rock with no hot fissures
capture_review_checklist: Front shot shows crust versus fissure separation.
Three-quarter shot keeps cracks readable through specular hotspots.
Grazing shot still reads the emissive network without flooding the frame.
The shell remains darker than the fissures in all three benchmark angles.

build_material_crack_mask_lane.goal: Establish a readable fissure mask before any shell tint or edge polish is added.

build_material_shell_core_lane.goal: Turn the fissure mask into cooled crust versus hot internal separation.

build_material_fresnel_lane.goal: Add restrained edge polish only after crust and fissure readability are stable.

branch_restart_triggers: orange tint with no crust separation
